lines.ruling: Ruling: scope; refusal located elsewhere; restatement accepted. i1040gi p. 110, Schedule 1-A, Line 22, column (ii), 'enter the amount of the QPVLI, if any, that was deducted elsewhere on your return (for example, on Schedule C, Schedule E, or Schedule F)'. Schedule F is refused (scope.farm), and car, truck or travel costs of a rental are refused (rental.vehicle, on Schedule E line 6), so Schedule C is the only place the return can deduct this interest; the question asks for the part of this loan's interest deducted there. Same ruling as the earlier rounds; the form was re-reviewed because lane fx-itemized changed its note (entries named by the VIN).
